title: Ioannes Tzetzes, Exegesis of the Iliad / Иоанн Цец, Экзегеза к «Илиаде»
author: John Tzetzes
size: Long introduction plus commentary on Iliad 1; est. ~50k words.
edition: Papathomopoulos, Athens 2007 (in copyright). Hermann 1812 is PD; its completeness is unverified.
ru_evidence: Ru-wiki 'Иоанн Цец' lists the Exegesis among his works and gives no translation. The only Russian Tzetzes items are 1969 excerpts and Smyka's Carmina Iliaca.
en_evidence: Search found no English translation; only the Allegories (DOML 2015, 2019) are translated (BMCR 2015.09.45, 2020.03.07).
value: Byzantine prolegomena on Homer's life, poetics and allegory; Tzetzes' early method. Complements his Allegories and Eustathius, and is important for the history of Homeric reception.
ai_feasibility: Medium. Polemical, idiosyncratic prose. The PD text is uncertain, so editorial checks are needed.
pilot_unit: The introduction (Homer's life, genres, allegory); est. ~15k words.
